$meta.figmaFileKeyProvenance: ASSERTED, NOT MEASURED — the Figma desktop MCP serves the active tab and never reports a file key.
$meta.nodeIdRelationship: 26955:66554 is the SECTION; 26938:65997 is its child COMPONENT SET. Parent/child, not a conflict. Record the component-set id for mappings.
$meta.readThisFirst: Figma's generated docs for this component say '6 variants' and omit state=ai; they also state line-height 120% / letter-spacing -0.24px, which the bound variables contradict. Trust the bound variables.

padding.why: Figma codegen emitted p-[var(--spacing/none,1px)] — a spacing/none token with a misleading 1px FALLBACK. Arithmetic ruled it out (1+26+34+1=62 matches all 7 symbols; padding:1 gives 64). Now confirmed by Figma's own spec text: 'Padding 0px all sides'.
padding.generalTrap: A Figma codegen fallback is not a token value.

width.note: 360 is the variant's own width; the component description says 100% width

labelGapSlack.arithmetic: row 1 is 26px, label content is 22px -> 4px empty row below the label
labelGapSlack.warning: The designer's documented 'Gap 4px between top and bottom' is REAL but is grid slack, NOT a CSS gap property. Do not implement it as `gap`.

variantAxis.name: state
variantAxis.resolution: Trust the 7 — measured from the component set's symbol children.

states.defect: NO background is emitted. Figma codegen: ${isDisabled ? "" : 'bg-[var(--field/bg-default,white)]'} — the disabled branch is an empty string. Renders white/transparent, not grey.
states.doNotFix: Do not apply #f1f5f9 or field/bg-disabled. That would invent a look Figma does not show. Needs a design decision.

contradictsFigmaProse.resolution: The bound variables win. Figma's prose is stale.

typography.tokenGap: G2 — fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0 is bound in Figma but ABSENT from tokens.css

optionalElements.blocker: Both exist in the sub-component but are OFF in all 7 published variants. There is currently NO supported way to show a required marker on this component — a hard blocker for clinical forms with mandatory fields. Needs Singh's decision.

sizeChoice.note: SPEC-12's 30/40px pair belongs to a DIFFERENT component and does not apply here.

implementationRisk.issue: A Material mat-form-field appearance="outline" CANNOT produce this layout.
implementationRisk.why: Material renders the label as a floating notch that INTERRUPTS the top border. Fields type 1 renders it as a static full-width 22px row stacked ABOVE the input, inside an UNBROKEN border. Different structures, not different skins.
implementationRisk.consequence: No amount of token overriding converts one into the other.
implementationRisk.decisionRequired: Either build a custom control, or redraw the design to match Material. Decide BEFORE producing an implementation diff.
implementationRisk.goodNews: The 17 --field-* semantic tokens already exist in every theme file. Tier 2 is complete; only a correctly-structured Tier 3 consumer has ever been missing.

openTokenDecision.promotionRule: 3+ distinct consumers earns a global token (Curtis's rule)
openTokenDecision.assessment: 34px currently has 2 consumers (this input row + the table header) — BELOW the threshold, so it stays component-local rather than becoming a global token.
